explanation: Selected or appointed; describes that God chose believers before the foundations of the world were laid to be holy and blameless.
Set apart from sin, cleansed, and dedicated to God's service; a status granted through Jesus' blood.
The concept that God determined beforehand that believers would be adopted as his children through Jesus Christ.
God's undeserved favor and goodwill toward people, not earned by them but given freely to save them.
The payment or redemption price; refers to Jesus' death as a release from the penalty and power of sin.
The restoration of the relationship between God and humanity, where hostility is removed through Christ's sacrifice.
A truth previously hidden from people but now revealed that all nations will share in God's kingdom together with the Jews.
The concept of perfection or totality; describes how God dwells in the church and fills it to the full through Christ.
